data.one_liner: Detects and validates device clock changes using NTP
data.what_it_does: FlutterTimeGuard monitors manual date/time/timezone changes and compares the device clock against trusted NTP servers. It caches the last valid timestamp for offline use and triggers callbacks when tampering is detected.
use_when: Protecting OTPs, signed tokens or time‑limited credentials
Ensuring compliance in attendance or workforce apps
avoid_when: Apps that do not rely on accurate device time
Environments where NTP access is blocked or unreliable
weaknesses: No support for web or desktop
data.setup_notes: Add dependency via pub add, optional verbose logging, no extra permissions needed
